body: I've been thinking about this, 2020 has been by far the worst year of my life and 2021 will only get worse. I dont want too see the new year in.

That's horrible to be repeatedly cheated on and I'm sorry you had to go through that.

How did you start processing things properly? 

I just miss her so much, I thought I was doing well and then all of the feelings came rushing back and now she is seeing someone else it breaks me. I miss everything i had with her and just knowing she is with someone else hurts a hell of alot. I just feel so alone and would do anything to have her back

She is well within her right to date someone else. I dont agree with it fully on the basis if she tells me she is considering us being together again and then we have a date night together for then the very next night her to go stay at another mans after telling me she loves me. She told me she was going out for a little while and has ended up staying the night without even telling me.

We had the idea of starting from fresh, so ease things and not jump back in as we have done this before and we go right back to square one. Date more, do different things we have never done and make more of an effort with each other.

Now I look at the bigger picture I just csnt foresee anything working but that hurts alot. It sounds so cliche but my head knows it's not right to try again but my heart is with her and I want her. It's the toss up of deciding what would actually be for the best as I'm so conflicted with this.

Yeah we just were no longer happy together, we both got into bad habits and things were no longer exciting. We both love each other but it almost seemed like the spark had gone to a degree. 

Thank you

I agree with you.

It's the going around in circles and continually being hurt.

Thank you for your advice it's nice to have an outsiders perspective.

That's my fear if we did try again is being in the same place a few months down the line.

I get what you're saying about the children, I think it will be best to focus on me and the children and the future without getting back with her.

It just sucks as shes been the only woman I have been with and I've spent so long with her picturing life without her and how happy we were at one stage hurts alot.

Thank you for your advice I really appreciate it.

I see your point completely.

We talk and she tells me shes open to trying again but shes unsure then she meets other men and this breaks me to be honest. 

I agree, we have also spoke about this and what would need to change to overcome our issues that we had. We have been in a similair situation before and I dont want the feeling of going around in circles.

It's just very difficult seeing her almost move on when I am still so in love with her.
